prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE standalone construction-proof panel, NOT a comic page or multi-view sheet. Reference1 supplies Sean identity, proportions and faded vintage ink/colored-pencil palette ONLY; do not copy its old carrier. Full-body rear three-quarter view of Sean walking normally across a quiet hotel corridor, orange workshirt, blue overalls, bald head gray chin goatee visible in profile, normal compact adult, white boot covers. Both arms relaxed swinging with free clearance; one foot stepping forward. No Tony. New practical carrier: a LONG normal wooden plunger, red rubber CUP AT TOP behind his RIGHT shoulder, straight wooden HANDLE POINTS DIAGONALLY DOWN across his BACK to LEFT rear hip/upper thigh, never dangling between legs. Tool about 90cm long for a 170cm adult, red cup ~15cm wide. Simple narrow stiff leather-backed sheath mounted diagonally against back. CLOSED LOWER TOE socket captures wooden HANDLE TIP and bears weight; show tip seated in this visibly closed-bottom socket. TWO separated snug quick-release leather shaft straps attach to same backing, one just below red cup at upper back and second near waist, separated about35cm, visibly encircle wood to prevent tipping/sliding/swinging. Lower closed toe about10cm below lower strap. Backing anchored to a shoulder baldric and belt at opposite ends, so assembly cannot swing. Cup high behind shoulder, clear of head/neck; shaft held close to back, bottom ends above gluteal fold/upper thigh not near knee. Keep blue overall straps distinct. Plain practical brown leather, small dull brass fasteners, no ornamental harness maze. Camera must show entire cup, straight shaft, BOTH spaced restraints and closed weight-bearing toe, belt anchorage and clear silhouette around arms and legs. Construction readable, restrained colors, warm paper grain, angled perspective. No lettering or labels or arrows. This is early mechanics proof, not polished publication. Never cup-down, no shallow hip basket, no floating parts, no extra tool, no anatomy change.
